The '''Tashelin Serenading Droid''' was a model of [[musician droid]] that existed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Tashelin Serenading Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a courting gift for companions.
